summary.text: George Austin is the Republican nominee for Connecticut's 2nd Congressional District; he is also on the ballot as the Independent Party of Connecticut nominee. A first-generation American, he describes himself as a tradesman and homebuilder for the past twenty years and is a first-time candidate. He says he is running on affordability, tax relief and housing costs.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a first-generation American.
Graduated from South Windsor High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Central Connecticut State University in 2014.
Has worked as a contractor; describes himself as a tradesman and homebuilder for the past twenty years.
Describes himself as a first-time candidate who accepted both the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut nominations for Congress in 2026; the August 11 Republican primary was canceled.
Describes himself as a husband and father of two young men.
